faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about recording your podcast at Yas Pro
faq.q1: Can I record with remote guests on Zoom or Riverside?
faq.a1: Yes. Our broadcast audio interfaces and ATEM switcher seamlessly pipe remote caller audio and video directly into the multi-cam recording with dedicated mix-minus channels.
faq.q2: How fast do I receive my finished files?
faq.a2: Raw camera ISOs and audio stems are transferred to your drive immediately at the end of the session. Full master episode edits are delivered within 48 to 72 business hours via secure cloud storage.
faq.q3: Can you create viral vertical reels for TikTok & Instagram?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Select our Standard Reel or 3-Highlights add-on during booking. Our editors extract high-retention moments, add animated captions, sound effects, and color grade for maximum engagement.
faq.q4: Where is the studio located and is parking available?
faq.a4: We are located at Iris Bay Tower, Level 18, Business Bay, Dubai. Dedicated guest parking is available with prior notice, or valet is accessible at the tower entrance.
